playing off the (sport) slogan "a good offense is the best defense"
Sometimes a good defense is the best defence. #PA;Increase the rate at which shields are boosted #AA;Immediately casts a self shield
来自敌方术士的恩惠 #PA;使持有者免疫中毒 #AA;召唤树精

The staff was specially crafted for warfare, and is designed to help the wielder survive just a little bit longer. #PA;Physical Resistance Aura. #PA;Double wielder's maximum hit points #AA;Arcane Bolt
这是一把带着死神诅咒的镰刀 会使持有者的肌肤一片片撕裂。 #PA;生命魔法抵抗 #AA;喷溅毒液

The long-lost sceptre of the ancient and charming troll king. #PA;Makes enemies less likely to attack the wielder #AA;Charm target

Goblin Wizards tend to use this staff to lengthen their lifespan -- which isn't very long to begin with. #PA;Increased Physical Resistance #AA;Temporary Damage Immunity
胜者为王败者为寇，这根古老而残 破的法杖只愿意跟着前者走。 #PA;抵抗所有元素 #AA;瞬间传送
The goblin lord kept this relic safe for many a year, until it finally slipped from his grasp… his cold, dead grasp. #PA;Resistance to all elements #AA;Teleport
从某只恶魔身上掉下来的断臂， 它拥有无尽的神秘力量。 #PA; 光束类法术持续时间无限 #AA;无

它赋予持有者近乎于吸血鬼的力量！ #PA;生命魔法从此伤害你！ 奥术魔法免疫 #AA; 从最近目标吸取生命

生命法杖是一个奇特的物品： 看着像从土壤中自然生长出来的。 #PA;范围再生光环 #AA;复活同伴玩家
originally found "concealed", growing in a garden row.
The staff of life is a peculiar item: it seems to spontaneously grow in gardens. #PA;Regeneration Aura #AA;Revive
在紧急情况下非常有用，可以使你 脱离自身所处的不利环境到安全一 些的地方去。 #PA;无 #AA; 传送持有者至随机位置
Useful in emergency situations, when anywhere is better than where you currently are. #PA;None #AA;Teleports the user to a random location

"Through the fire and flames" -- 100% guaranteed. (The staff, that is.) #PA;Fire Resistance #AA;Fire Immunity Aura
“只有我的超远程电磁炮才能狠 狠地激射至无尽的天边……” 这根叉叉会自己唱歌？ #PA;增加放电范围 #AA;电磁炮
Lightning staves are rarely used in the field, due to their haphazardous nature. #PA;Increased lightning range #AA;Lightning bolt
远程好远程妙…遇到反射就乱套 #PA;无 #AA; 反射范围光环
A staff specially devised for combating enemies who favor missile weapons. #PA;None #AA;Deflect Aura
白袍巫师曾经是个灰袍。因同伴们 的强烈要求，他再一次回到了中原 大地协助他们作战，随后领了便当。 #PA;增加光照半径 #AA;恐惧
The white wizard was once a different color, but returned to Midgård once again to aid his fellow wizards in their quest. Then subseqently died. #PA;Increased light radius #AA;Fear-causing light
卖给刺客应该会有个好价钱 #PA;无 #AA;隐形术

A staff used by the dwarven priests of Galdrhöll. #PA;Lightning Immunity Aura #AA;Lightning Damage Aura
曾经有一名巫师打造了一个法杖来 增强自身的魔法，想借此超越他人 #PA;所有魔法伤害+1 #AA;无
Once there was a wizard that forged a staff to increase the powers of his spells, to gain the edge over his "peers". #PA;Adds one to all spell damage #AA;None

A strange contraption with several moving parts. Far too advanced to be part of a fantasy game. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Fast, Ranged
一把精心制作的战斗用刀， ……似乎在哪儿见过！ #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;快速, 增加移动速度
A finely crafted combat knife. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Fast, Increases Movement Speed
亚瑟王的咖喱棒，很出名哟！呃还 带着石头… #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;慢速, 击倒
The famous sword in the stone – complete with stone. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Slow, Knockdown
a joke on Bilbo Baggins' blade, Sting. (Lord of the Rings)
大师打造的精灵之刃。 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;快速，当敌人接近时发光 (喂喂真的吗)
A masterly crafted elven blade. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Fast, Glows when enemies are near
一把来自东洋的快刀，刀把上 刻着这样的文字“独一无二” #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;快速，穿甲
A curved exotic blade from the far east. The words "There can be only one" are inscribed on its hilt. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Fast, Armor Piercing
它很轻，挥动迅捷，能够烧穿几乎 所有物质。 #DMG;高奥术伤害 #SP;快速
It is very light, can be swung very quickly, and burns through almost any material. #DMG;High Arcane #SP;Fast
一只骷髅形状的戒指。这家伙在肉 搏战中一定能留下印记。 #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;击倒
A skull-shaped ring. This puppy could really leave a mark if it were used in a fist fight. #DMG;Low Physical Damage #SP;Knockdown

Crafted in a blizzard, this sword must have been a hassle to forge. #DMG;Medium Physical and Cold #SP;Slow, Creates a cold blast in front of the wielder

A blade which can cleave a man in two, forged by a very tenacious dwarf. Given away for no apparent reason. #DMG;High Physical #SP;Slow, Armour Piercing
这是一把永远能击中目标的神剑。 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;永远命中，试试就知
A sword that, according to legend, always hits its target. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Always hits
一把充满暗黑力量的坚实战锤。 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;击退目标
A powerful hammer of the dark and gritty sort. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Pushes target back
A powerful hammer of the dark and gritty sort. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Pushes target back
充满了闪电力量的锤子。 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;慢速, 击中时闪电打击目标

投掷出去并且总能返回主人身边的 矛，就像其他北欧神话里的投掷 武器一样。 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;慢速, 远程, 穿甲
A spear that can be thrown but always returns to its owner. – Like all other thrown weapons in Norse mythology. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;Slow, Ranged, Armour Piercing
矮人出品，冠军必备。 #DMG;高物理伤害 #SP;慢速
Made by champions -- for champions. #DMG;High Physical #SP;Slow
乍看它就像一根普通的棍子。但这 根棍子上穿着十分美味的香肠。 #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;快速,吸引敌人攻击
At first glance, it just looks like an ordinary stick. But this baby comes equipped with a very tasty-looking sausage. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Fast, Makes enemies more likely to attack you
一把精致的剑，最适于屠龙… 附近有龙吗？ #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;能够杀死龙哦

只是一把斧头，但也许比巫师们配 备的钝剑要好 #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;无
An axe of good quality, at least in comparison with the blunt blades of the Wizard Order. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;None
在巫师城堡偶尔能找到一把利剑， 一般情况下应该立即磨钝的， 不过…… #DMG;中物理伤害 #SP;无
Every now and then, a sharp blade is found in Castle Aldrheim. Regulation states that it should immediatly be handed over for blunting. #DMG;Medium Physical #SP;None

"The Magick Swan": an excellent choice for prying things open. Things like armor. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Fast, Armor Piercing
一般哥布林制造的装备不值得大家 上心，不过这些高层哥布林用的 好玩意是个例外。 #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;快速

A magical dagger forged by Men in times long forgotten. #DMG;Low Physical #SP;Poison
拥有强大的破空之闪光，由长风海 岸曾经存在的德鲁伊制造. #DMG;中物理伤害和闪电伤害 #SP;无

Everyone longs for a cool breeze on those warm summer days. Now you can have your wish – and more! – with a powerful, refreshing blizzard. Guaranteed to chill even the warmest of beverages.
与人打交道的终极魔法， 只对意志薄弱的家伙起作用。 顺带一提，它们数量可观。
The ultimate magick for having your way with people. Only works on the weak-minded, which, by the way, is a rather sizable number.
感觉像气波功？ 用它的热浪， 你可以点燃大量的敌人， 或者大量的香肠.
Feeling like spontaneously combusting things? With this heat wave, you can torch large hordes of enemies -- or truly vast quantities of sausages.
洗去烦人的污点， 法术和状态效果， 更多洁净更多欢乐， 我就喜欢！
Removes bothersome stains, spells and status effects. Nullify is 42% more effective than other leading brands!
发出冷彻灵魂的号叫， 把最强的敌人吓跑。 这玩意能使你的主角光环大亮， 珍爱生命，拒绝配角，远离便当。
Unleash a soul-chilling howl that scares off even the most hardened foe. This baby will make your black-metal-band so famous that you might even be able to quit your day job.

Coats the immediate area with a greasy, highly flammable, slippery, cheese-like substance. The smell is a bonus.

When danger rears its ugly head, this magick makes it a lot easier to bravely run away.
你拥有了一双隐形的翅膀。 关键时刻可以令自己从对手眼前消失，远离尴尬的境地。

不需要祈雨就能召唤雨神， 人行道乐了，下水道哭了。
Call upon the rain Gods without having to resort to dancing. Makes crops happy and lava streams sad.

As your friends drop dead one by one, you might wish to revive them so the enemy might attack them instead of you. Plus, they might even return the favor someday.
这个法术很给力， 能够召唤死神领域的领主来帮助你。 但要小心，这位收割者喜怒无常， 喜欢勾走离他最近的家伙。
It is a powerful ability indeed, to call upon the aid of he who controls the ethereal realm. Be cautious though, for the reaper will claim whoever nearby is closest to death.
让施法者召唤出百变的元素精怪， 你用啥魔法碰它们， 它们就会变成啥属性。

召唤稀有而傲娇的凤凰， 它会直冲地面，横扫战场， 飞舞的火焰将成为新生的摇篮。
The rare and proud phoenix sweeps over the battlefield, and as it perishes in flame, it revives all fallen wizards in its fiery blast.

让施法者召唤僵尸帮助战斗， 完全蔑视死神的权威。
Showing total disregard for the permanence of death, the caster calls upon the deceased to aid him in battle.

In a hurry to get somewhere? That pesky barrier blocking your way? Teleportation is the key to lightning-fast travel. Don't want to strain those legs now, do you?
有些人认为这是雷神的把戏。 其他人认为这是科学。 不管怎样，当这个巨大的光束带给 你的敌人(和朋友！) 灭顶之灾时， 他们都该跑着找掩护！

带大家体验2012震撼的末日效果， 当然也包括你自己。

召唤绝对变态螺旋扭动体，自带方向感！
Summons absolutely insane weather – with a twist!
当你想搞破坏时，使用黑洞漩涡法术 绝对是明智之选！它能制造一个把所有 东西都吞进去的神秘漩涡。这吸力 是如此之强，以至于所有接近的东西 都会被撕成碎片！

如果你的附近……有奇怪的东西……用这个法术能把虚空的怪物 扯进现实空间。
If there's something strange... in your neighborhood... just use this magick to draw those ethereal creatures in to the corporeal realm.

时速88公里大冲刺(穿越时空)
